title: Omni Demand Understanding: A Benchmark for Contextual User-Intent Inference in Multimodal Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2609.21392v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Natural audio-visual interaction is emerging as an important interface for AI assistants, allowing users to communicate through speech and vision rather than carefully composed text prompts. However, existing benchmarks of interactive capabilities still focus primarily on response quality, leaving a more fundamental question underexplored: can a model correctly infer the user's underlying demand from complex multimodal interaction? Real-world user demands are often underspecified in speech and must be inferred from multimodal cues and dialogue history. This inference is further complicated by ambiguous or disfluent expression and noisy acoustic environments. Conversely, request-like speech may not constitute a demand to the assistant, leading to false triggers. translated_title: 全需求理解：多模态交互中基于上下文的用户意图推断基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.21392v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：自然的视听交互正在成为AI助手的重要接口，使用户能够通过语音和视觉进行交流，而无需精心编写文本提示。然而，现有的交互能力基准主要关注响应质量，而一个更根本的问题尚未得到充分探索：模型能否从复杂的多模态交互中正确推断用户的潜在需求？现实世界中用户的需求在语音中往往表述不完整，需要从多模态线索和对话历史中进行推断。这种推断还会因模糊或不流畅的表达以及嘈杂的声学环境而变得更加复杂。相反，看似请求的语音可能并不构成对助手的需求，从而导致误触发。我们将全需求理解确立为一个独特的多模态上下文推断问题：给定一个交互流，模型必须检测用户需求是否存在（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了全需求理解（ODU）这一全新的多模态上下文推断基准任务，要求模型从含噪、模糊的视听交互流中判断用户是否真正提出了需求，填补了现有基准只关注响应质量而忽视需求推断能力的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Omni Demand Understanding (ODU), a new benchmark for multimodal contextual inference that requires models to detect whether a genuine user demand is present in noisy and ambiguous audio-visual interaction streams, addressing a gap in existing benchmarks that focus solely on response quality.
